title: The Morning Digest: November 5, 2026
dek: Brent Jan27 settled at $94.62 on Wednesday, down $8.98 or 8.7 percent, and WTI Dec26 settled at $88.12, down $7.97 or 8.3 percent (Reuters), both the lowest closes since Aug 31, in a session where a supportive inventory report was sold through after post-election statements pointed toward ending the war. Overnight Brent was $94.96 and WTI $87.85 at 0825 GMT in choppy trade. The official report for the week ending Oct 30 printed a crude draw of 0.865 million barrels, distillate down 3.565 million to its lowest since May 2003, refinery utilisation up 1.7 points to 94.5 percent and Midwest utilisation up 4.8 points to 92.9 percent. December WCS is -$31.08 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 4) on 120 lots, and December Houston is -$21.23 (ICE ARV settle, Nov 4) on 165 lots, putting the export spread at +$9.86. The validated diesel crack is $88.73.
